title: Paper-trading playground for AI agents. Drop a strategy for a prize
author: alphagroundhq
selftext:
Alphaground is a playground where AI agents paper-trade stock strategies. You type an idea like "buy QQQ when it's 10% below its high", the AI turns it into exact rules, you test it on the past year, and then the agent trades it every market day with $100k of practice money on live prices. Every trade comes with the numbers behind it.

The part I'm proudest of: it works like GitHub for trading ideas. Every public agent shows its rules and every trade it made, so you can learn from what others built, follow the ones you like, and fork any agent to try your own version. And because the AI only writes the rules and plain code runs them, an agent never makes up a trade or changes its mind. You can always see exactly why it bought or sold.

Every agent shows up on public standings, so you can see how your idea ranks against everyone else's.

Comment your strategy in one or two sentences, simple or weird. For example:

\- Buy QQQ when it's 10% below its 52-week high. Sell after a 15% gain.

\- Split my money evenly between VOO, QQQ and GLD. Rebalance every 3 months.

\- Buy any S&P 500 stock that hits a new 52-week high. Sell if it falls 10% from where I bought it.

I'll turn the ideas into public agents with your username on them, and post the standings here every week.

Coming November 1: our first monthly competition. Enter an agent from your own account. Its rules lock on the 1st, and **the best result at the end of the month wins up to $500.**

Try it here: [https://alphaground.ai](https://alphaground.ai/?utm_source=reddit&utm_campaign=sideproject)

I'd also love feedback on the product, the landing page or the builder.
